domainConstruction: Runtime is constructed ACTIVE; controller alone owns preparation/disposal of application resources.

ownership.semantics: One StepPracticeRuntime owns attempt identity, exact pitch-set verdict and target progression for all inputs.
ownership.orchestration: One StepPracticeController requests retirement and commits runtime rearm.
ownership.retirement: Input-specific StepRetirementPolicy establishes a safe same-domain physical watermark.
ownership.presentation: Hook mirrors controller snapshots and sends commands; no semantic timer or direct rearm.

ready: Session ACTIVE, input available, attempt READY, current target exists, no fatal input error. canAcceptAttempt derives from runtime state plus application lifecycle/error; hooks do not own it.
eligibility: Finite same-domain eventTime > inputEligibleAfter; equality is ignored.
boundedCurrentEvidence: Non-READY may contribute only to the already-open fixed gesture. No second gesture, queue, carryover, future-target reassignment or rolling pitch bag.
completeAttempt: Exactly one immutable verdict record; active attempt cleared; POST_VERDICT with runtime-owned pending transition. Answered target remains current. No advancement or final-scope completion.
rearm: Explicit finite same-domain nonbackward watermark, ACTIVE/POST_VERDICT and available input required. Retires <= watermark; consumes pending transition exactly once. MATCH advances and exposes next target plus READY atomically. Final MATCH completes scope here. MISMATCH/RETRY retain target and become READY.
skip: READY and available input only; runtime-owned separate skip history and progression. Busy skip is a no-op and cannot cancel the bounded gesture.
stop: Explicit user stop can end the session without applying pending advancement. It cannot fabricate SCOPE_COMPLETED.

midi.retirementWatermark: PracticeTimebase.runtimeToSessionTime(clock.nowMs()) at actual rearm/READY commit, not previous captureEnd.
midi.lateCallback: Preserved MIDIMessageEvent.timeStamp <= watermark remains permanently ineligible even when delivered after READY.

microphone.futurePolicy: Capture continues without Pause/Resume. After its future qualified retirement condition, capture owner supplies physical capturedThrough projected into the same session domain. Old/late evidence <= watermark cannot open a fresh attempt.
microphone.H50: Historical acoustic within-attempt grouping, not cooldown and not requalified here.

disconnect.READY: Input unavailable; no attempt accepted until explicit fresh reconnect watermark.
disconnect.CAPTURING_ANALYZING: Invalidate unfinished identity, cancel input timer, retain target/session; stale completion rejected. Fresh reconnect watermark required.
disconnect.POST_VERDICT: Preserve finalized record/pending transition and phase. Reconnect restores input with fresh watermark but only explicit controller rearm applies pending transition once.

metronome: Answered target during POST_VERDICT. Context changes only after runtime commits MATCH rearm (or explicit READY skip).

historicalQualification.v3_v10: Immutable exposed development/historical evidence of OLD lifecycle; no historical result rewritten or promoted.
historicalQualification.futureDevelopment: Candidate/corpus design may be reused only as exposed DEVELOPMENT evidence with independently accepted V12 semantics and a new protocol.
historicalQualification.normalUsability: Paced note learning, not rapid-retrigger performance recognition.
historicalQualification.safetyScope: CAPTURING outside the open bounded gesture, ANALYZING and POST_VERDICT input cannot create attempt2, queue, carry over, advance or become next-target evidence. Busy/late stress remains mandatory. Old busy/late denominator rules are not automatically future shipping gates.

portableToolingLesson: Windows absolute filesystem paths cannot be passed directly to dynamic ESM import(). Future tooling must use pathToFileURL(absolutePath).href. V11 is not repaired or executed.
